recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No follow-up core source work is needed for FHIR-24865; keep FHIR-22842 as duplicate background rather than a separate reconciliation decision.
issue_request: FHIR-24865 was a Published/Persuasive Vocabulary change request for FHIR-core CodeSystem. It asked to replace an incorrect CodeSystem.status detailed-description definition that described the created/revised date with: "The status of this code system. Enables tracking the life-cycle of the content."
initial_application: Git commit 27b184d04790893f6ff56757454031e29bf64ff9 applied FHIR-24865 by changing source/codesystem/structuredefinition-CodeSystem.xml from the obsolete date wording to the requested status/life-cycle wording. Later metadata-resource refactoring preserved the corrected definition.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists codesystem=CodeSystem, confirming the StructureDefinition source is in current build scope. Vocabulary Confluence minutes for 2022-03-21 record FHIR-24865 as resolved change required and note that FHIR-22842 would be resolved as a duplicate. Corrected Zulip searches found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/codesystem/structuredefinition-CodeSystem.xml defines CodeSystem.status exactly as requested, and current source/codesystem contains the corrected wording without the obsolete date wording.
